# Kynov

> Agile sprint tracking and workspace management web application.

## Overview
Kynov is a modern sprint planner and task workspace designed for rapid product cycles, sprint swimlanes, and backlog issue filtering.

## Core Features
- Sprint Planning and Kanban Swimlanes
- Backlog Issue Filtering and Priority Management
- Workspace Collaboration and Member Roles

## Links & Endpoints
- [Documentation](/docs): Project architecture and guides. (2K tokens)
- [App Dashboard](/board): Interactive sprint board. (5K tokens)
